summary: Advance your career with AI in Real Estate training. Learn Automated Valuation Models, predictive analytics, and PropTech strategy. Enroll for expert-led sessio
lede: AI in real estate uses property data to support valuation, asset management, and investment decisions. For real estate analysts, property managers, and investors, this course covers building automated valuation models, forecasting rental and market trends, and using IoT data to plan predictive maintenance.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals who manage, analyze, or invest in physical assets and need to leverage data-driven technologies to maintain a competitive edge.
audience: Urban Planning Consultants using predictive analytics
modules: Data Engineering for Real Estate Assets
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3 years of experience in real estate investment, property management, or asset strategy. Familiarity with basic data analysis using Excel is required. No prior programming knowledge is necessary, though an understanding of the property lifecycle is essential.
